Perfect! **Ne3+** is the best move. After Ne3+, White is in check and every king move (Kh3, Kh2, Kh1, Kg1) allows Qxh5 winning (with Kh3 being checkmate). If White recaptures with Rxe3, Black plays Qxh5 winning the rook outright.

**Best move:** Ne3+

**Main line:** Ne3+ Kh3 Qxh5#

**Motif:** fork

**Coaching note for club player:**

When your opponent leaves a piece undefended, look for forcing moves—especially knight checks. This knight fork attacks both the king and the undefended rook on h5. Every king move allows you to capture the rook with check or even mate. The pattern: look for a forcing check when the opponent has a loose piece.
